sections.introduction:
Ark Pudina is a classical Ayurvedic herbal distillate prepared from the Dried Pudina ( Mentha piperita ). It is known for its potent digestive, detoxifying, and anti-inflammatory properties due to which it effectively supports gastrointestinal health by alleviating indigestion, flatulence, nausea, and abdominal pain. Additionally, Ark Pudina aids liver function, promotes regular bowel movements, and enhances overall vitality. This natural, fast-acting formulation balances the Pitta and Vata doshas and is widely used as a safe remedy for digestive and metabolic disorders.

sections.description_of_the_ingredient:
Pudina ( Mentha piperita ) (Dried) 
 It is commonly known as peppermint, and is rich in volatile oils such as menthol, menthone, and menthyl acetate, which give it potent digestive, carminative, antispasmodic, and cooling properties. It works by stimulating digestive enzymes and bile secretion, relieving indigestion, flatulence, nausea, and abdominal cramps through its muscle-relaxing and gas-reducing actions. Its cooling effect helps to pacify the Pitta dosha, reducing internal heat and inflammation, while its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory compounds support liver function and detoxification. Additionally, Pudina aids respiratory health by acting as a mild decongestant and mucolytic. These combined effects make dried Pudina effective in managing digestive disorders like indigestion (Ajeerna), flatulence (Afra), vomiting (Chhardi), abdominal pain (Udarshoola), and weak digestion (Mandagni), as well as respiratory ailments such as cough and cold. 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take 1 part of the Dry Pudina and soak it in 10 parts of water. 
 The next morning, transfer the mixture into an Arka Yantra and extract 20 bottles of Ark from it. 


 Medicinal Properties 

 Supports natural detoxification by cleansing the digestive system and purifying the blood, promoting overall vitality. 
 Possesses antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects that protect against oxidative stress and enhance immune health. 
 Aids digestion, supports liver function, and promotes regular bowel movements, contributing to balanced metabolism and holistic wellness
